item.title: Pitch Update: Farnborough (A)
item.description: At 9:30 am, the pitch has been inspected by a suitably qualified match official, supplied by the FA and has been passed fit to play. He was only able to take the current pitch conditions into account. The post Pitch Update: Farnborough (A) appeared first on Dagenham & Redbridge FC.

item.title: Rest in Peace Pam St Pier
item.description: It is with great sadness that we must advise that Pam St Pier sadly passed away on Tuesday at the age of 80. The post Rest in Peace Pam St Pier appeared first on Dagenham & Redbridge FC.

item.title: Farnborough (A) Postponed
item.description: Following the pitch inspection conducted by the Referee, the rain that was forecast has rendered the pitch unplayable due to standing water. Apologies to all those who travelled. The post Farnborough (A) Postponed appeared first on Dagenham & Redbridge FC.

item.title: Sam Howes Red Card Rescinded
item.description: We can confirm that Sam Howes’ Red Card shown during our recent fixture against Horsham F.C. has been rescinded following a successful appeal. The post Sam Howes Red Card Rescinded appeared first on Dagenham & Redbridge FC.
